description: Defines the FusedKernel class used in PyTorch's JIT code generation for fused GPU/CPU kernels, including its data members, constructor, and virtual methods.

classes.name: FusedKernel
classes.description: Represents a fused computational kernel with associated metadata, capable of launching the kernel and providing information about its inputs, outputs, and configuration.

methods.name: launch_raw
methods.description: Pure virtual method to launch the kernel with given arguments.

methods.name: backend
methods.description: Returns the backend (CPU or CUDA) associated with the kernel.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the fused kernel.

methods.name: code
methods.description: Returns the code string of the fused kernel.

methods.name: chunkDesc
methods.description: Returns descriptions of input chunks for fusion.

methods.name: hasRandom
methods.description: Indicates whether the kernel involves random operations.
